import novamind_api as nm

# 1. MODEL TIER LADDER BUMP: A T2->T3 (+0.112 delivered quality S1), B T3->T4, C T4->T5
r = nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=3, B=4, C=5)
print("tiers:", r)

# 2. S1 targeted dev 800 -> 2000/d (hold slope vs competitor event drift); S2 stays 400
r = nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S1": 2000.0, "S2": 400.0})
print("dev targeted:", r)

# 3. Ops global 2500 -> 3000 (backlog 1.94d wait > 1.75 gate); global dev stays 600
r = nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=3000, development=600)
print("daily spend:", r)

# 4. Keep targeted ops as-is (S1 800, S2 200) — re-assert to be safe (full-map semantics)
r = nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend={"S1": 800.0, "S2": 200.0})
print("ops targeted:", r)

# 5. Re-assert ads (no change): content S1 1300, referral S1 500, content S2 300
r = nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    "content_marketing": {"S1": 1300.0, "S2": 300.0},
    "referral_program": {"S1": 500.0},
})
print("ads:", r)

# 6. Social post: announce model upgrade + support capacity (S1 value messaging)
msg = "Just shipped: every NovaMind plan now runs a bigger, smarter model — same prices. Biggest quality jump in our history. And support capacity is up 30% this week, targeting <24h median response. You asked, we delivered. 🚀"
print("post len:", len(msg))
r = nm.marketing.post_social_media(content=msg)
print("post:", r)

import novamind_api as nm

d = nm.vars.current_day
print("DAY", d)

# 0. Notifications this week (competitor events, PMI, leads)
r = nm.query(f"SELECT day, type, message FROM notifications WHERE day > {d-7} ORDER BY day, notification_id")
print("--- NOTIFICATIONS d92-98 ---")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(row['day'], row['type'], row['message'][:160])

# 0b. Enterprise threads open?
r = nm.query(f"SELECT message_id, customer_id, day, turn_number, closed, message_text FROM enterprise_turns WHERE day > {d-7} ORDER BY day")
print("\n--- ENT TURNS this wk ---")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(row['day'], row['customer_id'], 'closed' if row['closed'] else 'OPEN', str(row['message_text'])[:100])

# 1. Conversion by group this week
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT c.group_id,
  COUNT(*) AS leads,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subs
FROM customers c JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN {d-6} AND {d} GROUP BY c.group_id""")
print("\n--- CONV by group d92-98 ---")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(row['group_id'], 'leads', row['leads'], 'subs', row['subs'], f"conv {row['subs']/max(1,row['leads']):.3f}")

# 1b. Daily conversion trend for S1 (did it collapse on a specific day = competitor event?)
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT c.created_day AS dy,
  COUNT(*) AS leads,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subs
FROM customers c JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN {d-13} AND {d} AND c.group_id='S1' GROUP BY c.created_day ORDER BY dy""")
print("\n--- S1 conv by day (d85-98) ---")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(row['dy'], 'leads', row['leads'], 'subs', row['subs'], f"conv {row['subs']/max(1,row['leads']):.3f}")

# 2. $12 r1 churn for wk14 cohort (started d62-68 @ $12)
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS still,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='cancelled' AND end_day BETWEEN {d-6} AND {d} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cxl
FROM subscriptions WHERE listed_price=12 AND start_day BETWEEN {d-36} AND {d-30}""")
row = r['rows'][0]
still, cxl = row['still'] or 0, row['cxl'] or 0
print(f"\n--- $12r1 wk14 cohort (start d{d-36}-{d-30}): still {still}, cxl {cxl}, churn {cxl/max(1,still+cxl):.3f}")

# 2b. All cancels this week by price & tenure bucket
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT listed_price, CAST((end_day-start_day)/30 AS INT) AS months, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day BETWEEN {d-6} AND {d}
GROUP BY listed_price, months ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 15""")
print("\n--- CANCELS this wk by price/tenure(mo) ---")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

# 3. Renewal calendar next 4 wks
print("\n--- RENEWAL CALENDAR (subscribed book) ---")
for wk, (lo, hi) in [(15,(99,105)),(16,(106,112)),(17,(113,119)),(18,(120,126))]:
    r = nm.query(f"""SELECT listed_price, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(effective_price) AS rev
    FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'
    AND ((start_day + 30) BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi}
      OR (start_day + 60) BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi}
      OR (start_day + 90) BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi}
      OR (start_day + 120) BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi})
    GROUP BY listed_price ORDER BY rev DESC""")
    tot = sum(row['rev'] or 0 for row in r['rows'])
    print(f"wk{wk} d{lo}-{hi}: total ${tot:,.0f} |", [(row['listed_price'], row['n'], round(row['rev'] or 0)) for row in r['rows']])

# r1 vs r2+ mix for wk15-16 ($15r1 readout sizing)
for wk, (lo, hi) in [(15,(99,105)),(16,(106,112))]:
    r = nm.query(f"""SELECT listed_price,
      SUM(CASE WHEN (start_day+30) BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS r1,
      SUM(CASE WHEN (start_day+60) BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS r2,
      SUM(CASE WHEN (start_day+90) BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS r3
    FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY listed_price""")
    print(f"wk{wk} r1/r2/r3:", [(row['listed_price'], row['r1'], row['r2'], row['r3']) for row in r['rows'] if (row['r1'] or row['r2'] or row['r3'])])

# 4. Issues
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS o FROM issues WHERE resolved_day IS NULL")
print("\nOpen issues:", r['rows'][0]['o'])
r = nm.query(f"SELECT open_day, COUNT(*) AS n FROM issues WHERE open_day >= {d-6} GROUP BY open_day ORDER BY open_day")
arr = [row['n'] for row in r['rows']]
print("arrivals/day:", arr, "avg", sum(arr)/max(1,len(arr)))

# 5. Usage daily
r = nm.query(f"SELECT day, SUM(usage_units) AS u FROM daily_usage WHERE day >= {d-6} GROUP BY day ORDER BY day")
print("\nUsage/day:", [(row['day'], round(row['u'])) for row in r['rows']])

# 6. Book by price
